_comment: Signed risk acceptances for vulnerability findings that have no available fix.
This file is NOT a suppression list. An entry here changes one specific
finding from `failed` to `accepted`, and nothing else: a different
advisory, a different package, or a second high finding in the same package
still fails the gate. Every entry must carry an approver, a date, a
reachability argument and an expiry, and the gate fails when an entry is
expired, when required fields are missing, or when an entry no longer
matches any reported finding (stale entries fail, so an acceptance cannot
outlive the problem it was written for).
`expires_on` may not be more than MAX_ACCEPTANCE_DAYS in the future.
Raising this file's ceiling is a reviewable diff like any other.
